title: Ka Melody Jong Ka Ri (Melody of the Homeland)
description: Lyrical ballad in classical Khasi praising the streams, whistling pine breezes, and rolling green hills.

khasi: Ha ki lum ki them ba phyrnai,
Rwai ko sur ka duitara ksiar,
Sngewthuh ko para baieit ka ri,
Ha u slap bad ka jingshai ka sngi.
english: Across the radiant hills and valleys,
Sing, O melody of the golden duitara,
Hearken, O beloved children of the motherland,
Through the rain and the golden sunshine.

khasi: Ki khlaw kyntang ki phuh ki syntiew,
Ka um sunon ka tuid jai jai,
Pynneh ia ka burom u Hynniewtrep,
Haduh ban da wai ki aïom pyrthei.
english: In the sacred groves the flowers bloom,
The crystal river flows gently and clear,
Preserve the honor of the Seven Huts,
Until the seasons of the world have run their course.

vocabulary.hynniewtrep: the Seven Huts / original primordial Khasi ancestors
